method: Independent review of exact 16 kHz HTDemucs vocal stem spectrogram, four CTC paths and bounded attention candidates; selected intervals are not treated as ground truth. Starts are generally set near coherent CTC phoneme onsets, except sustained tokens where CTC lands late; word releases are extended only when coherent CTC and spectral structure support them. Distinct silence gaps remain unhighlighted.
limitations: A spectrogram cannot certify lexical identity.
ASR/CTC models share errors; confidence is qualitative, not probabilistic.
No human slow listening performed by this agent; user must review ambiguous wording and held-token boundaries in playable preview.
